patch_description:
This version retains the unit-square hull normalization and population-based differential evolution from the stronger current implementation, while incorporating the active-constraint focus and annealing-style non-greedy acceptance idea from the crossover program.

The implementation improves efficiency by storing and evolving only the nine free points during global search, evaluating candidate batches vectorially, and using a smaller elite set of high-quality finalists for active-triangle polishing. The final refinement preferentially moves points participating in the currently smallest triangles, with limited early simulated-annealing acceptance to escape active-constraint traps before switching to strict maximin improvement.
